description: Brave Kampala's busy markets with Nakato.

choices.label: Ndi bulungi. (I am fine.)
choices.reply: Nakato claps. "Ndi bulungi! Then the market will be sweet."

choices.label: Tusanyukidde! (Nice to meet you!)
choices.reply: Nakato beams. "Tusanyukidde! Come, Kampala is waiting."

scene1.culture: In Buganda, greetings are long and warm; rushing them is considered rude.
scene1.translation: "How are you, visitor?" Nakato greets you with a bright smile.

choices.label: Webale nyo! (Thank you very much!)
choices.reply: You thank the traders, your basket filling with fruit.

choices.label: Tugende! (Let's go!)
choices.reply: You dive into the colourful crowds together.

scene2.culture: Owino market in Kampala is one of East Africa's busiest; bargaining is done with humour.
scene2.translation: "Let's go to the market!" The stalls overflow with matoke and mangoes.

scene3.culture: The boda-boda motorcycle taxi was born at the Kenya-Uganda border.
scene3.translation: "Goodbye!" The boda-bodas buzz past as you wave.

title: Nakato's Kampala Market
